scope: Six packaged compute shaders dispatched with their original root signatures. The Radeon reference uses native 64-lane exchanges in the same translation. The portable path uses workgroup memory for each logical wave.
inputs: 8 by 8 RGBA32F point-sampled textures with zero, a per-channel spatial gradient, and the gradient scaled by 1.75. Ray generation uses identity camera matrices and a 32 by 32 dispatch tile.

2550.outputs: 1024 32-byte records. Matched by the packed source pixel coordinate (word 3) because the order of records in an atomic bin can vary. Checked a guard record before and after the UAV view.

3391.outputs: Three RGBA32F textures; 8 by 8, 4 by 4 and 2 by 2 active regions in 8 by 8 views. All three readback buffers compared including untouched guards and padding.
